provenance_policy: Strict distinction between chronological plot milestones (Canon) and behavioral evolution metrics (Analysis).

events: Initially distrustful and aloof toward Fuutarou Uesugi alongside her sisters
Secretly conceals her passion for Sengoku warlords out of embarrassment
Fuutarou studies historical warlords to engage her, prompting her to accept him as tutor
Becomes the first sister to actively cooperate and study with Fuutarou

behavioral_evolution.tone_with_fuutarou: Guarded initially, rapidly shifting to earnest respect and tentative companionship
behavioral_evolution.primary_motivation: Overcoming her fear of being judged for her niche interests

narrative_progression.narrative_arc: Season 1, Episodes 4–12: Awakening Feelings & Academic Drive

events: Recognizes her growing romantic feelings for Fuutarou during the Fireworks festival
Sets a goal to achieve the highest score among the sisters on the midterm exams
Achieves the top score in Social Studies, proving her capability
Takes part in the Legend of Fate ski trip and bonds with Fuutarou in the snow

behavioral_evolution.tone_with_fuutarou: Shy, subtly flirtatious, seeking his approval and recognition
behavioral_evolution.primary_motivation: Earning the right to stand beside Fuutarou as an equal

narrative_progression.narrative_arc: Season 2, Episodes 1–4: Seven Goodbyes & Sisterhood Loyalty

events: Mediates between Nino and Fuutarou during their intense fallout
Stands up against their father's attempts to replace Fuutarou with a hired tutor
Reaffirms that all five sisters must stay united to succeed

behavioral_evolution.tone_with_sisters: Decisive, principled, protective of the household
behavioral_evolution.primary_motivation: Protecting the quintuplets' unity and Fuutarou's place in their lives

narrative_progression.narrative_arc: Season 2, Episodes 7–8: Scrambled Eggs & The Identity Crisis

events: Suffers an acute identity crisis at the hot springs inn, fearing she is indistinguishable and lacks individual worth
Grandpa identifies her while disguised as Itsuki through her subtle gait, deeply touching her
Fuutarou successfully identifies her through love and observation, triggering a major breakthrough
Disguised as Itsuki, kisses Fuutarou beneath the Bell of Vows

behavioral_evolution.confidence_level: Critical Turning Point (breaks free from feeling interchangeable)
behavioral_evolution.tone_with_fuutarou: Emotionally exposed, deeply vulnerable, passionately grateful
behavioral_evolution.primary_motivation: Being recognized as an individual uniquely loved for who she is

narrative_progression.narrative_arc: Season 2, Episodes 9–12: Sister's War & The Kyoto Confession

events: Works at a local cake shop to practice baking and become proficient at making sweets
Experiences severe heartbreak when Ichika disguises herself as Miku to deceive Fuutarou
With the unified support of all four sisters, confesses her feelings to Fuutarou at Toei Kyoto Studio Park
Playfully defers the confession to point at her sisters to preserve harmony while leaving her feelings clear

behavioral_evolution.primary_motivation: Expressing her authentic feelings openly without regret

narrative_progression.narrative_arc: The Movie: Hinode Festival & True Self-Worth

events: Takes leadership of the Class 3-1 pancake stall during the school festival and resolves class disputes
Achieves mastery in baking and takes immense personal pride in her craft
Confesses clearly to Fuutarou in the classroom on festival night and kisses him
Accepts Fuutarou's ultimate choice of Yotsuba with maturity, grace, and sisterly love
Discovers that her self-worth and love for cooking exist independently of whether she was chosen

behavioral_evolution.primary_motivation: Pursuing her personal dream and embracing lifelong sisterhood

events: Attends and graduates from a culinary vocational institute
Opens and successfully co-manages a bakery and cafe with Nino in Tokyo
Happily attends Fuutarou and Yotsuba's wedding ceremony alongside her sisters

behavioral_evolution.tone_with_all: Warm, mature, comfortable in her own skin, enduring dry humor
